content.title: Top 10 US spring break cities, weather forecasts for March 21-28
content.text: Updated March 18, 2026, 1:55 p.m. ETFlorida and other warm-weather locations are top domestic spring break destinations, according to AAA Travel data.Weather forecasts for late March 2026 predict sunny, warm conditions for Florida, California and Las Vegas.Travelers heading to New York City and Chicago should expect cooler temperatures with a mix of sun and clouds.Spring break is here, and travelers are heading to the country’s most popular destinations.AAA Travel data shows that Florida dominates this year’s top domestic destinations, with warm-weather spots leading the list as travelers seek sun, beaches and theme parks. But some may be in for a surprise if they’re heading to a cooler city, where temperatures could be far from beach-worthy.From sunny beaches to bustling city streets, here’s the forecast for March 21‑28 in the Top 10 U.S. spring break cities — so you can plan when to hit the sand or the sights next week.When is spring break 2026?According to AAA, spring break runs from early March into mid‑April. But data from Voyista, a travel and destination site, shows that the week of March 14-21, 2026, has the highest number of colleges and universities on break, making it the peak week for spring break travel among college students.For K‑12 schools, the week of March 28 is the most common, with nearly 30% of breaks, followed by March 14. Forecasts are currently too far out to accurately predict weather for late‑March breaks.1. Orlando, Florida, spring break weather forecastKicking off the weekend of March 21, according to the National Weather Service in Orlando, conditions here will be dry and warming up, with sunshine building in and highs climbing from the mid-70s Friday into the low to mid-80s by Sunday and Monday. Skies will stay mostly clear to sunny, with light winds and low rain chances — setting up a near-perfect stretch of spring break weather.By early next week, the pattern holds steady with continued sunshine and highs in the mid-80s through Monday. Rain chances return Tuesday, when scattered afternoon thunderstorms become possible, though much of the day will still be partly to mostly sunny.Best days for theme parks and outdoor fun: Saturday, March 21, through Monday, March 23, bring the best stretch of the forecast, with sunny skies, light winds and comfortably warm temperatures — ideal for theme parks, pool days and outdoor dining.2. Fort Lauderdale, Florida, spring break weather forecastIn Fort Lauderdale, Florida, mostly sunny skies and warm temperatures are expected through Monday, March 23. Highs will reach the upper 70s Saturday, March 21, and rise into the low 80s Sunday, March 22, and Monday, March 23, with overnight lows in the mid‑60s. Skies will stay clear to mostly sunny, giving plenty of dry stretches for outdoor plans.By midweek, a few morning showers are possible Thursday, March 26, and Friday, March 27, though much of each day should remain partly sunny and comfortable. Outdoor activities may require a little flexibility, but brief wet periods shouldn’t disrupt most plans.Best days for beaches and outdoor fun: Saturday, March 21, through Tuesday, March 24, offer the clearest, sunniest conditions — perfect for beach trips, exploring local attractions or enjoying South Florida’s outdoor offerings. 3. Miami, Florida, spring break weather forecastLike the other Florida cities, mostly sunny skies and warm temperatures are expected in Miami from Saturday, March 21, through Monday, March 23. Highs climb from the upper 70s Saturday, March 21, into the low 80s Sunday, March 22, and Monday, March 23, with overnight lows in the mid‑60s. Skies will stay mostly sunny, giving plenty of dry stretches for outdoor plans.By midweek, a few morning showers are possible Thursday, March 26, and Friday, March 27, though most of the day will remain partly to mostly sunny. Outdoor activities may require some flexibility, but brief wet periods shouldn’t disrupt plans for walking the beach, shopping or dining outside.Best days for beaches and outdoor fun: Saturday, March 21, through Tuesday, March 24, offer the clearest, sunniest conditions — perfect for beach trips, exploring outdoor attractions or enjoying Miami’s sunshine.4. Anaheim/Los Angeles, California, spring break weather forecastMostly sunny skies are expected all week in Los Angeles, California, with virtually no rain in the forecast. Highs climb from the mid‑80s Saturday, March 21, into the upper 80s Sunday, March 22, and low 90s Monday, March 23. Nights remain mild in the upper 50s to low 60s, perfect for evening strolls or outdoor dining.By midweek, highs reach the low to mid‑90s Tuesday, March 24, through Thursday, March 26, making daytime outdoor activities more challenging. Morning and evening hours remain comfortable for sightseeing, hiking or trips to the beach.Best days for beaches and sightseeing: Saturday, March 21, through Monday, March 23, offer sunny but manageable temperatures — ideal for exploring the city, enjoying beaches, or hiking. Midweek, hotter highs in the 90s may limit prolonged outdoor time.5. Tampa, Florida, spring break weather forecastIn Tampa, Florida, mostly sunny skies are expected through the week of March 21–28, with very low rain chances. Highs reach the upper 70s Saturday, March 21, rising into the low 80s Sunday, March 22, and staying in the low 80s for much of the week. Overnight lows are mild, in the mid‑50s to low 60s, perfect for morning or evening outdoor activities.By midweek, skies remain mostly sunny, with only a slight chance of showers Tuesday, March 24, and Wednesday, March 25. Outdoor activities such as beach trips, park visits or exploring city attractions should be easy to schedule around any brief wet periods.6. Honolulu, Hawaii, spring break weather forecastSpring breakers heading to Honolulu, Hawaii, should prepare for a wet and breezy week. Showers and thunderstorms are likely Saturday, March 21, through Sunday, March 22, with the highest rain chances at the start of the week. Highs stay around 76-77°, with overnight lows in the upper 60s to low 70s. Winds remain breezy, with gusts reaching 20 mph or higher at times.By midweek, conditions improve slightly, with partly cloudy skies and lower rain chances Monday, March 23, through Thursday, March 26. Temperatures stay warm and stable, but windy conditions may continue, especially along the coast. Friday, March 27, is mostly cloudy, with continued mild temperatures.Best days for beaches and outdoor fun: Monday, March 23, through Thursday, March 26, offer the clearest breaks from wet weather, though gusty winds and limited sun may make beach trips less ideal.7. Las Vegas spring break weather forecastMostly sunny skies are expected all week in Las Vegas, Nevada. Highs climb from the upper 90s Saturday, March 21, into the mid-90s Sunday, March 22, through Wednesday, March 25. Thursday, March 26, brings slightly cooler temperatures in the upper 80s, before highs rise again into the low 90s Friday, March 27, and Saturday, March 28. Nights remain mild, in the mid-60s to upper 60s, perfect for evening strolls or outdoor dining.Midweek temperatures peak, making daytime outdoor activities more challenging, though mornings and evenings remain comfortable. The desert sun will be intense during the afternoon hours, so sun protection is recommended.Best days for outdoor activities: Saturday, March 21, through Wednesday, March 25, offer sunny skies with warm but manageable temperatures. Late-week highs are slightly lower, but the desert sun remains strong.8. New York spring break weather forecastExpect a mix of sun and clouds in New York City this week, with generally cool temperatures and low to moderate chances of rain. Highs start in the upper 50s Saturday, March 21, and Sunday, March 22, before dipping into the 40s Monday, March 23, and staying cool through Saturday, March 28. Overnight lows range from the low 30s to mid‑40s, so mornings and evenings will feel chilly.Skies are mostly clear to partly cloudy through Thursday, March 26, with only brief periods of rain possible. Friday, March 27, brings the highest rain chance of the week, though most days remain dry.Best days for sightseeing and outdoor plans: Tuesday, March 24, through Thursday, March 26, offer the clearest skies and the most comfortable windows for outdoor activities, though layering will be needed for the cool temperatures.9. Atlanta, Georgia, spring break weather forecastA mix of sun and clouds is expected in Atlanta, Georgia, this week, with generally mild temperatures and low chances of rain. Highs climb from the low 80s Saturday, March 21, into the mid-80s Sunday, March 22, before dipping to the upper 60s–low 70s by midweek. Overnight lows range from the upper 40s to upper 50s, making mornings and evenings cool and crisp.Skies remain mostly sunny Thursday, March 26, and Friday, March 27, with only occasional clouds or brief showers possible. Light breezes are expected throughout the week, creating comfortable conditions for outdoor activities.Best days for outdoor activities: Saturday, March 21, and Thursday, March 26, offer the clearest skies and the most comfortable conditions for parks, downtown strolls, or outdoor attractions.10. Chicago spring break weather forecastEarly in the week, Chicago, Illinois, experiences cool, windy conditions, with highs dipping into the 30s and 40s and overnight lows in the 20s and 30s. Saturday, March 21, starts partly cloudy and mild, while Sunday, March 22, brings colder temperatures with strong winds and clouds.By midweek, skies become mostly cloudy to partly sunny, with slightly milder highs in the 40s and 50s Tuesday through Thursday, March 24–26. Morning and evening temperatures remain chilly, so layering is recommended for outdoor activities. A few morning showers are possible Thursday, March 26.Best days for outdoor plans: Wednesday and Thursday, March 25–26, offer the clearest skies and the mildest temperatures of the week — ideal for sightseeing, walks, or light outdoor activity with a warm jacket.Weather watches and warnings across the U.S.Stay informed.
